name: pyyaml

YAML parser and emitter for Python

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "6.0.3"

package:
  name: pyyaml
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/P/PyYAML/pyyaml-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d76623373421df22fb4cf8817020cbb7ef15c725b9d5e45f17e189bfc384190f
  patches:
    - 0001-Ensure-we-do-not-end-up-wih-CRLF-line-endings-on-tes.patch
    - if: match(python, "<3.9")
      then: 0002-remove-setuptools-use-distutils-py38.patch

build:
  number: 3
  skip: match(python, "<3.8")
  noarch: ${{ 'python' if use_noarch }}
  variant:
    use_keys:
      - use_noarch
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if use_noarch else 0 }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - if: not use_noarch
      then: python
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - cython
    - setuptools
    - packaging
    - pip
    - yaml
  run:
    - if: not use_noarch
      then: python
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python >=${{ python_min }}
    - yaml

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - yaml
        - if: python_impl == "cpython" and not use_noarch
          then: _yaml
      pip_check: false
      python_version:
        - "*"
        - if: use_noarch
          then: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  license_file: LICENSE
  license: MIT
  summary: YAML parser and emitter for Python
  homepage: http://pyyaml.org/wiki/PyYAML
  repository: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml
  documentation: http://pyyaml.org/wiki/PyYAML

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jakirkham
    - msarahan
    - pelson
    - ocefpaf
